skill.name: wasmc-text
skill.description: Rust UTF8 string processing with capacity governed by aggregate runtime memory.

apis.delta: WIT owned strings/lists replace borrowed slices/iterators; Wasm32 indices/counts are u32. Strict UTF8 returns None on invalid input; lossy decoding is explicit. No normalization or locale state.
